title: ticket template: triage decision (template_version 2)
description: A person's decision on a possible duplicate or a dedupe-pending ticket (owner, 2026-11-04: a near match is never auto-merged and never lost; a person decides merge or separate). merge closes `ref` as a duplicate of `original_ref` and tells the original what it added; separate keeps both. The triager never approves their own triage (SOD_SELF_APPROVAL). KDEC-037.
